name: notifications-1
title: Notifications Sheet Panel
description: Notifications sheet opened from a bell trigger, with icon tiles, unread highlighting, timestamps, an unread count, and a mark all read action.

standards.purpose: Surface what changed without pulling the user out of their task.
useWhen: Background events matter to the user but are not urgent.
doNotUseWhen: The event blocks the current task — use an inline alert or dialog.

rules.check: Unread state is conveyed by text or an accessible label, not color alone.
Success, warning, and error variants match their meaning; never use success styling for failures.
At most three transient notices are stacked at once.
